columns.name: abbreviation
columns.description: the abbreviation of the state name

columns.name: county_with_highest_average_income_per_household
columns.description: the county with the highest average income per household in the state, with ties broken by the ascending order of the county

columns.name: num_asian
columns.description: the number of Asian in the state, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: num_counties
columns.description: the number of counties in the state, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: higher_avg_female_per
columns.description: Set to 1 if the state’s percentage of female population is higher than the average percentage of female population across all states, otherwise, set to 0

columns.name: greater_than_15_CBSA_metro
columns.description: Set to 1 if the state has greater than 15 distinct CBSA officers of metro type, otherwise, set to 0
